about: Well-known drug targets offered in the `proteinscope serve` overview. Each entry is one structure with a drug or tool compound bound. Add your own with the same fields; `id` is a PDB ID or AF-<UniProt>.

entries.name: EGFR kinase
entries.why: Lung cancer target; erlotinib sits in the ATP pocket of the kinase domain.

entries.name: ABL kinase
entries.why: The kinase behind chronic myeloid leukaemia, bound by the first targeted cancer drug.

entries.name: KIT kinase
entries.why: Driver of gastrointestinal stromal tumours; the same drug as ABL in a related pocket.

entries.name: VEGFR2 kinase
entries.why: Angiogenesis target; a type II inhibitor that reaches past the ATP site.

entries.name: HER2 kinase
entries.why: Breast cancer target, close relative of EGFR.

entries.name: CDK2
entries.why: Cell-cycle kinase with its natural ligand; a case where the pocket score misranks the ATP site.

entries.name: HIV-1 protease
entries.why: Classic structure-based drug design success in antiviral therapy.

entries.name: SARS-CoV-2 main protease
entries.why: Covid-19 target with a covalent peptidomimetic inhibitor.

entries.name: Trypsin
entries.why: Small charged S1 pocket: the binding site, but too small for a drug-like molecule.

entries.name: Thrombin
entries.why: Coagulation protease, target of oral anticoagulants.

entries.name: Angiotensin-converting enzyme
entries.why: Blood pressure target; a zinc metalloprotease and a widely prescribed drug.

entries.name: Oestrogen receptor alpha
entries.why: Breast cancer target; an enclosed hydrophobic ligand-binding domain.

entries.name: Androgen receptor
entries.why: Prostate cancer target with its natural hormone bound.

entries.name: PPAR gamma
entries.why: Type 2 diabetes target with a large, open ligand-binding pocket.

entries.name: Beta-2 adrenergic receptor
entries.why: Asthma target and one of the first high-resolution GPCR structures.

entries.name: Adenosine A2A receptor
entries.why: GPCR studied for Parkinson's disease, with an antagonist in the orthosteric site.

entries.name: Dihydrofolate reductase
entries.why: Antifolate target in bacteria and cancer; a textbook enzyme-inhibitor complex.

entries.name: Acetylcholinesterase
entries.why: Alzheimer's drug target with a deep, narrow active-site gorge.

entries.name: Cyclooxygenase-2
entries.why: Inflammation target; the selective COX-2 inhibitor uses a side pocket.

entries.name: HSP90
entries.why: Chaperone targeted in cancer through its ATP-binding pocket.

entries.name: KRAS G12C
entries.why: Long called undruggable; a covalent drug in a pocket that opens only when bound.

entries.name: BRD4 bromodomain
entries.why: Reader of acetylated histones; JQ1 mimics the acetyl-lysine.

entries.name: EGFR, predicted model
entries.why: The full-length AlphaFold model, to compare with the crystal structure 1M17.
